column1: # Spanish irregular lexicon. One row per base; prefixed derivatives
# (proponer, obtener, deshacer, conducir via the bound stem ducir)
# resolve by longest-base suffix match, except the EXACT_ONLY bases in
# src/spa.rs (ser, ir, ver, dar, estar, andar, haber, asir) whose
# suffixes collide with regular verbs (toser, mandar, mover, prestar).
#   lemma  pres1..pres6  subj (stem, or 6 comma-separated forms)
#   ieron, j absorbing the i of -ieron; both imperfect subjunctives and
#   the future subjunctive derive from the preterite 3pl)
#   fut_stem  pp  impf6(comma)  ger  imp2sg  pret6(comma)
